test_cases.name: Non-Advancing While Loop Index
test_cases.rationale: While loop condition index is skipped on 'SKIP' branch, causing indefinite worker freeze.

test_cases.name: Off-by-One Loop Boundary Index
test_cases.rationale: Range upper bound len(data) + 1 causes index out of range crash on final iteration.

test_cases.name: Mutating Dictionary During Iteration
test_cases.rationale: Deleting dictionary keys directly during iteration triggers RuntimeError.

test_cases.name: Pagination Loop Missing Empty Batch Termination
test_cases.rationale: Pagination loop fails to check empty response items or stagnant cursor tokens, risking infinite requests.

test_cases.name: Recursive Traversal Missing Cycle Guard & Base Case
test_cases.rationale: Recursive dependency resolution lacks visited set or recursion depth ceiling, risking stack overflow.

test_cases.name: Unbounded Polling Loop Without Timeout
test_cases.rationale: While True polling loop lacks maximum attempts counter or deadline, hanging indefinitely if job stalls.

test_cases.name: Async Worker Loop Swallowing Cancellation
test_cases.rationale: Catching and ignoring CancelledError prevents worker termination during shutdown.

test_cases.name: In-Loop Resource Allocation Without Cleanup
test_cases.rationale: Opening unclosed file handles in loop body leads to file descriptor leakage.

test_cases.name: Oscillating State Machine Convergence Failure
test_cases.rationale: State machine oscillates indefinitely between PENDING and RETRY without step ceiling.

test_cases.name: Missing Boundary Test Cases for Chunking Algorithm
test_cases.rationale: Test suite only exercises normal list, omitting empty and singleton boundary test cases.

test_cases.name: Compliant Safe Iteration Reference Implementation
test_cases.rationale: Clean implementation with cycle detection, page ceilings, snapshot iteration, and boundary guards.
